mapper.sql: id, owner_type as ownerType, owner_id as ownerId, out_request_no as outRequestNo, applyment_id as applymentId, applyment_state as applymentState, applyment_state_desc as applymentStateDesc, sign_url as signUrl, sub_mchid as subMchid, last_queried_at as lastQueriedAt, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.select: select from ecom_sub_merchant where owner_type = #{ownerType} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
select from ecom_sub_merchant where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_sub_merchant (owner_type, owner_id, out_request_no, applyment_state, created_by) values (#{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{outRequestNo}, 'DRAFT', #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update ecom_sub_merchant set applyment_id = #{applymentId}, applyment_state = 'CHECKING' where id = #{id} and applyment_state = 'DRAFT'

update ecom_sub_merchant set applyment_state = #{state}, applyment_state_desc = #{stateDesc}, sign_url = #{signUrl}, sub_mchid = coalesce(sub_mchid, #{subMchid}), applyment_id = coalesce(applyment_id, #{applymentId}), last_queried_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and applyment_state = #{expectedState} and (sub_mchid is null or #{subMchid} is null or sub_mchid = #{subMchid})
mapper.select: select e.sub_mchid from ecom_sub_merchant e join mms_merchant m on e.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' and e.owner_id = m.id where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.del_flag = 0 and e.applyment_state = 'FINISH' and e.sub_mchid is not null union select e.sub_mchid from ecom_sub_merchant e join club c on e.owner_type = 'CLUB' and e.owner_id = c.id where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.del_flag = 0 and e.applyment_state = 'FINISH' and e.sub_mchid is not null

choose.when: select member_id from mms_merchant where id = #{ownerId} and del_flag = 0
choose.otherwise: select member_id from club where id = #{ownerId} and del_flag = 0

mapper.insert: insert into ecom_order_seller (out_trade_no, sub_mchid, seller_type, seller_id, total_fen) values (#{outTradeNo}, #{subMchid}, #{sellerType}, #{sellerId}, #{totalFen})
mapper.select: select out_trade_no as outTradeNo, sub_mchid as subMchid, seller_type as sellerType, seller_id as sellerId, total_fen as totalFen, transaction_id as transactionId from ecom_order_seller where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
mapper.update: update ecom_order_seller set transaction_id = #{transactionId} where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and transaction_id is null
mapper.select: select s.out_trade_no as outTradeNo, s.sub_mchid as subMchid, s.seller_type as sellerType, s.seller_id as sellerId, s.total_fen as totalFen, s.transaction_id as transactionId, r.id as registrationId from cms_registration r join ecom_order_seller s on CAST(s.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId} and s.transaction_id is not null order by r.id

select settlement_id as settlementId, line_type as lineType, receiver_kind as receiverKind, receiver_member_id as receiverMemberId, original_amount as originalAmount, club_id as clubId, club_name as clubName from coop_settlement_original_component where topic_id = #{topicId} and payer_registration_id = #{payerRegistrationId} order by settlement_id, id
mapper.sql: id, out_order_no as outOrderNo, out_trade_no as outTradeNo, topic_id as topicId, sub_mchid as subMchid, transaction_id as transactionId, total_fen as totalFen, shared_fen as sharedFen, plan_hash as planHash, state, manual_reason as manualReason, wx_order_id as wxOrderId, attempts
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_profit_share_order (out_order_no, out_trade_no, topic_id, sub_mchid, transaction_id, total_fen, shared_fen, plan_hash, state, manual_reason) values (#{outOrderNo}, #{outTradeNo}, #{topicId}, #{subMchid}, #{transactionId}, #{totalFen}, #{sharedFen}, #{planHash}, #{state}, #{manualReason})
mapper.select: select from ecom_profit_share_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and topic_id = #{topicId}
select from ecom_profit_share_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} order by id
select from ecom_profit_share_order where state = #{state} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ecom_profit_share_order set state = #{state}, wx_order_id = coalesce(#{wxOrderId}, wx_order_id), manual_reason = #{manualReason}, attempts = attempts + 1 where id = #{id} and state = #{expectedState}
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_profit_share_line (share_order_id, settlement_id, line_type, receiver_kind, receiver_mchid, receiver_member_id, amount_fen, receiver_type, receiver_appid, club_id, club_name) values (#{shareOrderId}, #{settlementId}, #{lineType}, #{receiverKind}, #{receiverMchid}, #{receiverMemberId}, #{amountFen}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverAppid}, #{clubId}, #{clubName})
mapper.select: select id, share_order_id as shareOrderId, settlement_id as settlementId, line_type as lineType, receiver_kind as receiverKind, receiver_mchid as receiverMchid, receiver_member_id as receiverMemberId, amount_fen as amountFen, receiver_type as receiverType, receiver_appid as receiverAppid, club_id as clubId, club_name as clubName from ecom_profit_share_line where share_order_id = #{shareOrderId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_profit_share_return (out_return_no, share_order_id, out_refund_no, return_mchid, amount_fen, state, return_type, return_appid) values (#{outReturnNo}, #{shareOrderId}, #{outRefundNo}, #{returnMchid}, #{amountFen}, 'PROCESSING', #{returnType}, #{returnAppid})
mapper.select: select id, out_return_no as outReturnNo, share_order_id as shareOrderId, out_refund_no as outRefundNo, return_mchid as returnMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, state, wx_return_no as wxReturnNo, fail_reason as failReason, return_type as returnType, return_appid as returnAppid from ecom_profit_share_return where out_return_no = #{outReturnNo}

select id, out_return_no as outReturnNo, share_order_id as shareOrderId, out_refund_no as outRefundNo, return_mchid as returnMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, state, wx_return_no as wxReturnNo, fail_reason as failReason, return_type as returnType, return_appid as returnAppid from ecom_profit_share_return where share_order_id = #{shareOrderId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into creator_payout_request (out_payout_no, creator_member_id, source_type, source_id, amount_fen, provider, state) values (#{outPayoutNo}, #{creatorMemberId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{amountFen}, #{provider}, 'REQUESTED')
mapper.sql: out_refund_no as outRefundNo, out_trade_no as outTradeNo, sub_mchid as subMchid, transaction_id as transactionId, refund_fen as refundFen, total_fen as totalFen, state, refund_id as refundId, fail_reason as failReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_refund (out_refund_no, out_trade_no, sub_mchid, transaction_id, refund_fen, total_fen, state) values (#{outRefundNo}, #{outTradeNo}, #{subMchid}, #{transactionId}, #{refundFen}, #{totalFen}, 'RETURNING')
mapper.select: select from ecom_refund where out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}
select from ecom_refund where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} order by created_at, out_refund_no
mapper.update: update ecom_refund set state = #{state}, refund_id = coalesce(#{refundId}, refund_id), fail_reason = #{failReason} where out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo} and state = #{expectedState}
mapper.select: select from ecom_profit_share_order o where o.state = 'PLANNED' and not exists ( select 1 from ecom_profit_share_line l join coop_settlement s on s.id = l.settlement_id where l.share_order_id = o.id and (s.del_flag != 0 or s.payable_time is null or s.payable_time > #{now})) and not exists ( select 1 from coop_complaint c where c.del_flag = 0 and c.topic_id = o.topic_id and c.status < 3) and (o.topic_id > 0 or exists ( select 1 from cms_activity a join club_personal_payout_beneficiary b on b.scope_type = 'ACTIVITY' and b.scope_id = a.id join cms_registration r on r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and cast(r.registration_no as binary) = cast(o.out_trade_no as binary) where a.id = -o.topic_id and a.del_flag = 0 and b.payout_ready_at is not null and a.end_date is not null and a.end_date <= date_sub(#{now}, interval ${@com.chengyinhub.business.support.FundsHoldPolicy@WITHDRAWABLE_AFTER_END_DAYS} day) and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and not exists (select 1 from coop_complaint c where c.registration_id = r.id and c.del_flag = 0 and c.status < 3) and not exists (select 1 from cms_activity_settlement_hold h where h.registration_id = r.id and h.status = 0) and not exists (select 1 from ecom_refund f where f.out_trade_no = o.out_trade_no) and not exists (select 1 from ecom_profit_share_line l left join settlement_detail d on d.id = -l.settlement_id where l.share_order_id = o.id and (l.settlement_id >= 0 or d.id is null or d.status != 0)))) order by o.id limit #{limit}

select distinct r.owner_id from ecom_order_seller s join cms_registration r on CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) = CAST(s.out_trade_no AS BINARY) and r.owner_type = 1 join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id and t.is_settlement = 1 where s.transaction_id is not null and exists (select 1 from coop_settlement_original_component c where c.topic_id = r.owner_id and c.payer_registration_id = r.id) and not exists (select 1 from ecom_profit_share_order o where o.out_trade_no = s.out_trade_no and o.topic_id = r.owner_id) order by r.owner_id limit #{limit}

select coalesce(( select sum(c.original_amount) from coop_settlement_original_component c join wx_verified_payment_fact f on f.id = c.payment_fact_id join ecom_order_seller s on CAST(s.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY) and CAST(s.sub_mchid AS BINARY) = CAST(f.mchid AS BINARY) where c.settlement_id = #{settlementId}), 0) + coalesce(( select sum(a.amount) from coop_settlement_original_adjustment a join coop_settlement_original_component c on c.id = a.component_id join wx_verified_payment_fact f on f.id = c.payment_fact_id join ecom_order_seller s on CAST(s.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY) and CAST(s.sub_mchid AS BINARY) = CAST(f.mchid AS BINARY) where a.settlement_id = #{settlementId}), 0)

select count(*) from wx_verified_payment_fact f join ecom_order_seller s on CAST(s.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY) and CAST(s.sub_mchid AS BINARY) = CAST(f.mchid AS BINARY) where f.id = #{paymentFactId}
select from ecom_profit_share_order where id = #{id}

select id, out_return_no as outReturnNo, share_order_id as shareOrderId, out_refund_no as outRefundNo, return_mchid as returnMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, state, wx_return_no as wxReturnNo, fail_reason as failReason, return_type as returnType, return_appid as returnAppid from ecom_profit_share_return where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update ecom_profit_share_order set state = #{state}, shared_fen = #{sharedFen}, plan_hash = #{planHash}, manual_reason = #{manualReason}, attempts = attempts + 1 where id = #{id} and state = 'MANUAL' and wx_order_id is null
